info.name: Smart Cart API
info.description:
Smart Cart (Spring Boot + PostgreSQL) with real-time Razorpay payments.

**Setup**: import `SmartCart-Local.postman_environment.json`, select it, and fill `razorpayKeySecret` (and `razorpayWebhookSecret`) as *current values* - they stay on your machine. Start the backend with the same keys in `.env`.

**JWT**: login requests store `accessToken` / `adminAccessToken` and show decoded claims in the Visualize tab. Folder scripts log in automatically when the token is missing or expiring.

**Payments**: folder 04 creates a real Razorpay order and prints `payUrl`; pay it in the browser, then run 05.

item.description: 1) Checkout creates a real Razorpay order.  2) Open `payUrl` in the browser (signed in as the same shopper) and pay with Razorpay Checkout.  3) The backend verifies the signature, fetches the payment from Razorpay, captures it and pushes PAID live.  Nothing here can mark an order paid without a real Razorpay payment.
